title: Explainable machine learning for 2-year functional outcomes in older adults with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage in North China: external validation and health-system context.
summary: An explainable model predicted two-year functional outcomes in older adults with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage, with internal and external validation. The result is reported in the Frontiers in Neurology. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Methods develop and interpret ML models with internal/external cohorts
organization: Department of Neurosurgery, Cangzhou Central Hospital; Department of Neurosurgery, Tianjin Medical University General Hospital; Department of Pathology, Tangshan People's Hospital
